requested_import_capacity_mw.claimant: Shepherd Chartered Surveyors (selling agent, on behalf of landowner)
requested_import_capacity_mw.notes: Sale particulars state a grid connection application was submitted on 21 October 2024 for 500MW planned demand capacity.

evidence_basis: Selling agent's sale particulars only; no network operator, NESO queue entry, connection offer, voltage or substation identified. The site sits in the SP Energy Networks licence area, but the counterparty to the application was not disclosed.
notes: APRS repeats the 500MW grid-application figure. Whether Apatura's 2026 proposal relies on this same application, and whether it survived the 2025-26 connections-queue reform (Gate 1/Gate 2), is unknown.
